title: Caleb’s Heart
textBlocks:
Caleb followed the Lord 
with his whole HEART

Hello Bravehearts, in today’s Bible story we learn more about CALEB
We first met CALEB when he was 40 years old.
CALEB WAS A SPY.
He was one of the spies who Moses sent to go check out the promised land.

Caleb and Joshua reported good news to Moses. 
CALEB TOLD THE PEOPLE, 
”Let us go at once to take the land, we can certainly conquer it”
But the other 10 spies were full of fear and they told Moses not to go into the promised land!

NOW 45 YEARS HAVE PAST
CALEB IS 85 YEARS OLD NOW. 
AND HE REMINDS JOSHUA THAT BACK THEN HE WAS PROMISED LAND 
FOR FOLLOWING GOD WHOLEHEARTEDLY.
So CALEB gets a place called HEBRON
He even fights GIANT like warriors !

ALL THE WAY FROM NEW ZEALAND…
CALEB, TITUS and LIVI

Let us make potato heart art
YOU WILL NEED - YOUR MOM TO HELP MAKE THE POTATO STAMP:
A potato
A heart shaped cookie cutter (optional)
Paint & Paper
HAVE FUN - PLEASE SEND US SOME PHOTOS OF YOUR ART

Dear Lord Jesus
Thank you for the Bible.
Thank you for living in my heart.
Please make be strong and brave
Amen.
